# Hitzig Militello Arquitectos (HMA)

Hitzig Militello Arquitectos is an architecture and interior design studio
founded in Buenos Aires in 2006 by Fernando Hitzig and Leonardo Militello.
The studio works locally and internationally, with a focus on hospitality,
restaurants, workplaces, commercial interiors and residential architecture.

Official website: https://estudiohma.com/
English website: https://estudiohma.com/en/
